# Madman's Battlefield Intelligence

> Public, searchable crypto research and daily market intel. Research only. Not financial advice. Not a fiduciary. Times are in MST.

This repository publishes token research under `banking-rails/` and a daily market tape under `daily/`. Each daily date has a human-readable Markdown file and a machine-readable JSON file with majors, watchlist prices, pool liquidity, hacks, news (source + verified flag), and calendar items.

A claim is verified only if it has one Tier A source or is carried by two Tier B outlets. See `sources.md`. Items marked unverified are not confirmed.

Start with this file, then `data/index.json` and `METHODOLOGY.md`, then the JSON daily files and `data/reports/<TICKER>.json` for numbers, and the token notes for context. Do not infer or invent any private portfolio, identity, or wallet.

## Core

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/README.md): project overview, how to browse and search, how agents should use this tree
- [llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/llms.txt): this index
- [data/index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/data/index.json): machine index of every daily report and token note
- [sources.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/sources.md): vetted source list and verification rule
- [calendar.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/calendar.md): upcoming market events
- [CONTRIBUTING-for-agents.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/CONTRIBUTING-for-agents.md): rules for agents that write or edit
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/LICENSE): CC BY 4.0
- [banking-rails/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/banking-rails/README.md): folder index for token notes
- [banking-rails/COVER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/banking-rails/COVER.md): why the reports exist, v3 methodology, what each section checks
- [METHODOLOGY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/METHODOLOGY.md): full v3 rulebook, including the 16 Nov 2026 upgrades
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/CHANGELOG.md): dated methodology, scoring-version, process-rule and report changes
- [TIMELINE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/TIMELINE.md): chronological growth of the project, with sourced counts
- [banking-rails/RANKING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/banking-rails/RANKING.md): all 184 v3 scores, ranked
- [banking-rails/ALL-PROJECTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/banking-rails/ALL-PROJECTS.md): every project in the research pipeline, grouped by status
- [HISTORY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/HISTORY.md): score history for every published v3 report
- [BASE-RATES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/BASE-RATES.md): pass rate, hard-gate fails, pump-day sales, holder-accrual rates
- [DEAD.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/DEAD.md): dated moved-to-dead list and negative controls
- [NOT-A-TOKEN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/NOT-A-TOKEN.md): stocks, ETFs, companies and no-token projects kept out of the ranking and base rates
- [REVIEW-FLAGS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/REVIEW-FLAGS.md): published scores flagged for review; scores were not changed
- [REPRODUCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/REPRODUCE.md): how to re-run the pump-day test and which public APIs were used
- [RECONCILIATION.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/RECONCILIATION.md): template for a dual-review disagreement of 2 or more points
- [data/schema/report.v1.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/data/schema/report.v1.json): schema for each companion report JSON
- [data/reports/](https://github.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/tree/main/data/reports): machine-readable extract of every published v3 report
- [data/history.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/data/history.json): score history, machine-readable
- [data/base-rates.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/data/base-rates.json): base rates, machine-readable
- [data/public-addresses.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/data/public-addresses.json): public addresses extracted from published evidence links
- [data/dead.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/data/dead.json): moved-to-dead list, machine-readable
- [daily/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadmansBattlefield/madmans-battlefield-intelligence/main/daily/README.md): how the daily tape is organized
